segments.text:
V. 15.
To one he gave five talents, to another two, and to another one—And who knows whether (all Circumſtances conſidered) there be a greater Diſproportion than this, in the Talents of thoſe who have received the moſt, and thoſe who have received the ſeweſt? According to his own ability—The Words may be tranſlated more literally, according to his own mighty power. And immediately took his journey—To Heaven.
